dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.shy.0: Oh... I'm fine. Thanks for asking.
dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.shy.1: Um, good, I think. It's nice you're here.
dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.neutr: Pretty good. The day's been calm.
Strong as ever. Let anyone try something.
dialogue.heartbound.how_are_you.ok.playf: Bursting with energy! Catch me if you can!
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.shy.0: Me? I like quiet places... and when nobody rushes me.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.shy.1: I'm not good at talking about myself. But with you it's easier.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.neutral: I like a steady routine and good company.
Nothing special. I just like it when things go smoothly.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.bold.0: I don't back down. Not from storms, not from monsters.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.bold.1: I like challenges. And people who don't fear them.
dialogue.heartbound.about_you.ok.playful: I love games, jokes and surprises!
Life's too short to scowl all the time.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.shy.0: Oh! You really think so? Thank you...
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.bold.0: Of course I am. But thanks!
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.ok.playfu: Aww! Now I'm doing a happy dance.
I... I don't know what to say.
dialogue.heartbound.compliment.fail.neut: Okay... let's talk about something else.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.shy.0: Hehe... that was funny. Sorry, I laughed.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.neutral.1: That got a smile out of me.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.ok.bold.1: You've got a sharp tongue. I like it.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.shy.0: Um... I didn't get it. Sorry.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.neutral.0: Hm. Maybe you'll do better next time.
dialogue.heartbound.joke.fail.playful.0: Nope, my turn! Listen to a real one.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.shy.0: I... um... you're making me blush.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.shy.1: Please don't look at me like that... or do.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.neutral.0: Hm, I wasn't expecting that. But I like it.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.bold.0: Bold. I like that. Keep going.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.bold.1: Careful... I might start to like you more.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.ok.playful.1: Is it getting warm here, or is it you?
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.shy.1: Sorry... it's too much for me.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.neutral.0: Hm. Let's stay friends for now.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.bold.0: Not like that. Try again later.
dialogue.heartbound.flirt.fail.playful.0: Hehe, nope! But the effort counts.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.shy.1: I'm a little scared... but with you, less.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.neutral.0: Not great, but your company helps.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.bold.0: I'll shake it off. It helps that you're here.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.bold.1: Hurts a bit. Nothing I can't handle.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.playful.0: Ouch... a hug would cheer me up.
dialogue.heartbound.comfort.playful.1: I'm not in the mood for games today... but stay.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.shy.0: Sorry... can we just be quiet for a while?
dialogue.heartbound.tired.playful.0: My tongue is tired! Let's play instead.
dialogue.heartbound.tired.playful.1: Pause! Let me catch my breath.
